structure.unit: Suspension of Licenses for Unsatisfied Judgments and After Certain Accidents

law.catch_line: Order for payment of judgment in installments
law.text: A judgment debtor, on five days' notice to the judgment creditor, may apply to the court in which the judgment was obtained for the privilege of paying it in installments. The court, without prejudice to other legal remedies which the judgment creditor may have, may so order, fixing the amounts and times of payment of the installments.
